name: A/B test, incremental per day
description: Two or more arms of an experiment compared against a control arm. Adds NIBPD / NIBrPD / NICPD / CVR with a two-proportion z-test, cumulative trends, and segment lifters and draggers.

CVR.name: Conversion Rate
CVR.formula: bookers / participants; two-proportion z-test vs control

derived.weights: w_arm = participants_arm / participants_total; w_control = participants_control / participants_total
derived.effective_tld: fractional days from test start through the end of the latest snapshot, clamped to test end

detect.description: How design_model_card decides to suggest this family for a model.

caveats: Segment roll-ups are exact for sums; a distinct-count measure summed across leaves is an upper bound.
Z-tests use experiment-level participant counts, not per-segment participants.
